description: Source code for SSL client socket implementation and context management in the Chromium project, including functions for setting SSL key loggers, serializing protocols, managing SSL context configurations, and handling client certificates.

classes.name: SSLClientSocket
classes.description: Represents an SSL client socket with static methods for setting key loggers and serializing protocols.

classes.name: SSLClientContext
classes.description: Manages SSL configuration, client certificates, session cache, and observers for SSL client connections.

methods.name: SSLClientSocket::SetSSLKeyLogger
methods.description: Sets the SSL key logger for SSL client sockets.

methods.name: SSLClientSocket::SerializeNextProtos
methods.description: Serializes a list of NextProtos into a wire format for ALPN.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::CreateSSLClientSocket
methods.description: Creates a new SSLClientSocket with the given stream socket, host/port, and SSL configuration.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::GetClientCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves a client certificate and private key for a given server.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::SetClientCertificate
methods.description: Sets a client certificate and private key for a server, and flushes session cache.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::ClearClientCertificate
methods.description: Removes a client certificate for a server and flushes session cache.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to SSL context changes.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from SSL context changes.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::OnSSLContextConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in SSL context configuration.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::OnCertDBChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in certificate database and clears caches.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::NotifySSLConfigChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers of SSL configuration changes.

methods.name: SSLClientContext::NotifySSLConfigForServerChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers of SSL configuration changes for a specific server.
